coverage.name: Baca County
limitations: Checked 2026-09-26: the Baca County Clerk's official site is www.bacacountyco.gov (bacacounty.colorado.gov and other guessed hosts failed at the proxy with 502; bacacountyco.gov was reachable). The Elections page, the Election category listing, the 2026-09-18 'Election Notice' (Logic and Accuracy Testing notice for the 2026 General Election, Nov 3, 2026) and the 2026-05-22 'Baca County General Election' post were read. None of them contains a TABOR notice, sample ballot, ballot-content certification, or list/IGA of political subdivisions participating in the Nov 3, 2026 coordinated election. The site's WordPress media library (wp-json media endpoint, uploads since 2026-06-01 and searches for 'ballot', 'sample', 'tabor', 'coordinated', 'intergovernmental') shows no 2026 election documents (only Resolution 2026.14 on fire restrictions and a multi-use building RFP). County-level question content therefore could not be reviewed; re-check once the clerk posts the TABOR notice/sample ballot.

Colorado Health Foundation tracker (coloradohealth.org) returned HTTP 403 and its Wayback copy could not be fetched; web searches found no reported 2026 Baca County ballot question. Not used as a source.
